paper.title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
paper.central_claim: 从100个人类偏好演示自动进化并留存Skills/Tools评价库，在冻结VLM上提高图像编辑偏好判断并提供有效下游RL奖励。

provenance.notes: 派发指定agent_model=sonnet、actual_model=gpt-6.1-sol；未提供可独立绑定的运行凭据，不探测模型。

evidence.quote: a versioned collection of Skills and Tools that encodes accumulated evaluation knowledge.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存对象为Markdown评价知识和程序说明，不是权重。

evidence.quote: The proposal does not directly modify the committed Library.
evidence.support_explanation: 轨迹诊断先形成候选快照，非直接写入。

evidence.quote: An update is committed only when its validation accuracy strictly exceeds that of the current committed Library.
evidence.support_explanation: 严格准确率门控和回退；反复查询小验证集不是统计保证。

evidence.quote: The 100 preference demonstrations are sampled exclusively from the training split of EditReward-Data, while EditReward-Bench is disjoint and used only for final evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者声明选择数据与最终测试分离；没有独立运行核实。

evidence.quote: The frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B model scores only 30.3 by itself, so the full system improves it by +15.4 points through the evolved Skills and Tools injected at test time.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告最终系统对基座增益；同时引入路由器和额外调用，不能单独归因库进化。

evidence.quote: raising the base model from 3.32 to 3.52, whereas EditReward reaches 3.45.
evidence.support_explanation: 相同FlowGRPO设置下下游奖励使用结果；不证明无reward hacking。

evidence.quote: a systematic characterization of the capability, API cost, latency, and deployment trade-offs across Orchestrator backbones remains future work.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本与强编排器替代解释未关闭。

evidence.support_explanation: 作者指标说明为pairwise，但表1的K=4低数值及其他表述未解释机会水平，存在测量语义歧义。

evidence.quote: only 8.1% of Skill proposals were accepted
evidence.support_explanation: 提供失败候选接受率，非跨运行方差。

evidence.quote: we evolve a composable Skills-and-Tools Library that serves as a reusable evaluator context.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻对比定位为已有反思/技能范式的多模态评价特化。

evidence.quote: On the held-out MMMU validation set, accuracy improves from 79.6 to 80.7 (+1.1).
evidence.support_explanation: 额外领域证据是重新跑进化流程，不等于同一图像库零样本迁移。

G.reason: 明确评价标注昂贵与固定评价知识瓶颈，涵盖EditReward、Reflexion、ACE等谱系；未获得最近邻原文，尚不能证明上下文进化本身新颖。

M.reason: 错误类型对应新技能/工具/修改，训练诊断和候选门控可重建；工具仍由VLM执行、归因诊断未校验。

X.reason: 候选快照、严格改善提交、失败恢复、库去冗余和冻结后读取明确；未给噪声适应门控和冲突/版本生命周期细节。

E.measurement.reason: 人类偏好与独立编辑评测是相关指标；pairwise说明与K=4极低准确率表格的指标语义不清，下游reward hacking没有独立审计。

E.causality.reason: 同Qwen基座及相同FlowGRPO奖励对照支持系统效益；缺固定手写库、等预算编排器、gate-off/skill-tool拆解控制。

E.holdout.reason: 明确训练集100例和最终独立EditReward-Bench，GenAI跨集验证；约30例验证集反复用于选择不能作最终留出，未报告泄漏审计。

E.statistics.reason: 给1471比较分母、候选拒绝率及类别负增益，但无主结果区间或多次进化方差。

E.cost.reason: 完整全文及附录未报告端到端进化/API/token账单，作者列为未来工作；100标签不是总成本。
